risks.risk: Capacity/standard/serial not verifiable from the photo, which affects pricing and safety compliance.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped markings showing capacity (20kg), serial/standard, and any inspection dates.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used cylinder with unknown capacity/standard.

risks.risk: Leak-free status cannot be verified remotely; a cylinder that leaks is a major safety and cost risk.
risks.proof: Video/clip of a proper leak test at the valve/regulator connection (soap-bubble test) and/or a pressure test result.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven leak-free (worst case: treat as needing inspection/possible repair).

risks.risk: Valve/regulator compatibility and condition (seller says new, but not proven).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the valve/regulator (threads, connection type, any brand/model) plus a short safe demonstration of connection and operation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as valve/regulator condition unknown (worst case: assume may need replacement).

risks.risk: Cylinder body condition (rust/dents/pitting) may affect resale and safety.
risks.proof: Multiple-angle photos including the base and any dents/pitting; close-up of the most damaged area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn/dirty with possible cosmetic/structural concerns.

proof_requests: Send new clear close-up photos of the stamped markings (capacity/serial/standard/inspection dates) on the cylinder body.
Send a photo or document showing the recent test/certification stamp (must be readable).
Send a short video of the leak test at the valve/regulator connection (soap-bubble test) and show no bubbles.
Send close-up photos of the valve/regulator and the connection type; ideally include a short safe demonstration of connection.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only text and does not replace missing visual proof. Without readable markings and leak/test evidence, the item cannot be priced confidently and safely from the current photo.
